description: NOVA Downloader API — central resolve API for the NOVA desktop and mobile downloaders. Per-platform endpoints (/youtube, /tiktok, /facebook, /x, /soundcloud, /direct, /hls) served by one plain-JavaScript function (index.js). The API resolves a URL to stream URLs + headers; clients download bytes directly from CDNs. It never proxies file bytes.
name: nova-downloader-api
